units.CD9105-kazumba: Kazumba territory (Kasaï-Central; Bilomba, Kalomba, Mikalayi, Ndekesha and Tshibala secteurs) lies west and south-west of Kananga. It was a theatre of the 2016-2017 Kamuina Nsapu insurgency and the ensuing FARDC repression, but militias were dispersed and most surrendered by 2018-2019. No armed group is known to hold territory as of 2026; towns are policed by the PNC with FARDC and ANR elements, while villages rely on sparse PNC posts and customary chiefs. Live web research was unavailable in this run, so the assessment rests on background knowledge and default state presence with low-to-medium confidence.
